title: STRETCH OUTER — inner is horizontal, outer is WAY OUT

problem.was: All outer shells (ZK R×1.08, Golgi R×1.04, kids R×1.2) crammed against the globe edge. No space between inner and outer. Outer appeared to move around Kevin but had nowhere to GO.
problem.fix: Stretch EVERYTHING out. ZK → R×1.8. Golgi → R×1.5. Kids → R×2.4. Solar system orbits at R×1.15 to R×3.0. The gap between inner (globe) and outer (cosmos) is now VISIBLE SPACE.

fractal_kaleidoscope.what: Every other page is a VIEW INTO Gaia, not a separate page. Fractal reflections of the same organism.
fractal_kaleidoscope.mechanism: 6 kaleidoscope mirror axes radiate from center. Where they cross the ZK ring = reflection nodes. Each node = a different page/view.
fractal_kaleidoscope.result: Pages reflect off each other, adding distance + direction + flavor. Like looking through a kaleidoscope: same pieces, different arrangements, each view reveals something the others don't.

only_local_is_hud.what: The HUD (index.html) is the ONLY local thing. Everything else exists in outer space. Other pages LOOK AT Gaia — they are not Gaia.
only_local_is_hud.built_from_in_to_out: We started at null (center), built the organism (globe), then the Golgi (membrane), then the solar system (outer space). Each ring is a subsection of Gaia. Each page that renders = looking at a different ring.
